description: Inferred (all-source, Alex 2026-11-24) from FMOD-STUDIO-2.03-GLOSSARY: the glossary's kinds of object in an FMOD Studio project. Wwise is not covered, because its documentation refuses automated fetches (403).

kind.description: An event or snapshot is instanceable and triggered, controlled and stopped from game code; a parameter is an event property; a bus is a modular component of the mixer; a VCA is a volume property; a bank is a collection of events and assets.
